newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 10.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 10.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 56.19 points at 7,000.89 after February jobs data showed little upward pressure on wages, easing worries that the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates soon.

* Bank Indonesia will sell its stakes in several commercial banks in order to avoid conflict of interest for the central bank whose role is to control banks, central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said in Hong Kong on Saturday, the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported on Monday. The banks include Bank PDFCI, Bank Papan Sejahtera, Uppindo and Bank Ficorinvest.
* Tribal clashes around the mining town of Timika in Indonesia's remote Irian Jaya province continued on Saturday as residents said the death toll from the fighting had risen to five.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index ended 0.70 points higher at 683.81 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,395.50/6.00 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,395.25/6.0
* Bank PDFCI, Bank Papan Sejahtera and Bank Ficorinvest on reports the central bank, Bank Indonesia, planned to sell its stakes in the banks.
* Property firm PT Putra Surya Perkasa on reports that the firm estimated its 1996 net profit to be better-than-expected.
* Semen Gresik on reports it has changed its depreciation policy, which could have implications for its 1996 net profit.
* Multipolar on reports retail tycoon Hari Dharmawan planned to buy a large stake in the firm.
* Citatah on market talk of a possible private placement and rights issue.
